start.speaker: Elara
start.text: Potions, scrap, relics. I buy and I sell and I do not ask where a thing has been. Stock turns over every time you come back up.

choices.text: I am getting used to this.
Somebody is keeping count of us.
You could give me a better price.
Who did you buy this stall from?

many_deaths.speaker: Elara
many_deaths.text: Death is the tower's habit, not your failure. You come back because something down there decided you were worth relighting. Try not to ask what it burns.

veteran.speaker: Elara
veteran.text: You have climbed enough times that the echoes know your step. That is not the compliment it sounds like. Spend the knowledge before something spends you.

ledger.speaker: Elara
ledger.text: Of course somebody is. I have handled three of their receipts. Every one of them was written by a person who was very calm about the arithmetic.

price.speaker: Elara
price.text: I could. I will not. But I will tell you which of my stock came up out of the mire, and you will want to know that before you drink any of it.

elara_arc.speaker: Elara
elara_arc.text: Nobody. It was the Chapter's supply table. When the Chapter stopped coming up I kept the table and started charging, and the ledger has balanced every year since. That is not the same as being settled about it.
